batch: First two images and their per-image text prompts from the fixed COCO training replay, downsampled to 160 x 160. Same training initialization, no warmup, one MuSGD update.
measurement: L2(Jittor parameter increment - PyTorch parameter increment) / L2(PyTorch parameter increment), across all trainable parameters. In the fixed-gradient control, all 394 native unclipped gradient tensors are replaced by the corresponding PyTorch tensors before the native optimizer runs.

cumulative_changes.change: Baseline optimizer, using the corrected CPU BN and identical input preprocessing for all rows
Use nearest-even BF16, including the normalization denominator
Normalize before transposition and select left/right Gram orientation from the official MuSGD shape buckets
Accumulate the global CPU gradient norm in float64 before computing the FP32 clip coefficient

identical_input_matrix_control.comparison: Independent single-matrix replay of PyTorch's BF16 Newton-Schulz versus Jittor FP32 GEMMs rounded to BF16 at the same boundaries. Start both from identical official momentum input; this isolates arithmetic within the orthogonalizer.
identical_input_matrix_control.scope: Shows a residual due to CPU matrix-product arithmetic and iterative rounding for this matrix. Does not attribute every whole-model discrepancy to this mechanism.

reproduce_final: Run check_tp_step.py torch with --init, --batch and --fixture to generate the official gradient/update oracle.
Run check_tp_step.py jittor with the same paths and --report for the native end-to-end step.
Run check_tp_step.py fixed-gradients with the same paths and report to append the optimizer-only control.
